impact.summary: Homebrew download cache (~/Library/Caches/Homebrew/downloads/*, or $HOMEBREW_CACHE/downloads): bottles and source archives already installed or superseded.
impact.regeneration: Homebrew downloads the archive again if the formula or cask is reinstalled.
impact.offline_effect: Reinstalling or downgrading without the network is no longer possible. `brew cleanup` is the owner's own way to prune it; installed packages are not affected.
